truth_rule: 100/100 is permitted only for this explicitly closed benchmark denominator after every required capability is evidenced at parity and at least one frontier capability is evidenced superior. This snapshot does not establish whole-system or open-world 100/100.

projects.evidence_summary: Agents, tools, handoffs, guardrails, sessions and tracing are first-class runtime primitives.
projects.single_extra_feature: Native guardrail + tracing + session orchestration around agent handoffs.
projects.8x8_parity_gate: Prove equivalent per-tool guardrails, resumable sessions and trace correlation inside PCEF receipts.

projects.evidence_summary: Checkpointed graph state supports fault recovery, memory, human interruption, replay and time-travel forks.
projects.single_extra_feature: Checkpoint-level replay and forkable time-travel debugging.
projects.8x8_parity_gate: Add independently verified checkpoint fork/replay canaries across real native One-Fabric missions, not only repository process recovery.

projects.evidence_summary: Typed workflow graphs, superstep execution, checkpoints, human-in-the-loop and multiple built-in multi-agent orchestration patterns.
projects.single_extra_feature: Type-safe superstep orchestration with checkpointed multi-agent patterns.
projects.8x8_parity_gate: Prove typed message contracts plus deterministic fan-out/fan-in and checkpoint recovery through the production council/control plane.

projects.evidence_summary: Crews and Flows combine autonomous role-based teams with stateful, resumable, observable deterministic workflows.
projects.single_extra_feature: A mature Crew + Flow hybrid that cleanly separates agency from deterministic control.
projects.8x8_parity_gate: Demonstrate equivalent role-team ergonomics on top of PCEF without creating a second task bus.

projects.evidence_summary: Large workflow/integration surface with self-hosting, AI tools, source-controlled environments, security auditing and production operations.
projects.single_extra_feature: Production-grade visual integration automation with source-controlled environments.
projects.8x8_parity_gate: Close connector parity using typed capability manifests, environment promotion and auditable credential boundaries.

projects.evidence_summary: Strong evidence/truth-boundary architecture and PCEF convergence now include a versioned portable Agent State Capsule, strict finite-JSON and freshness checks, a real child-process death/reopen canary with durable duplicate suppression, and a versioned 9-case SPCA evaluation corpus. Native Android/Termux pickup, phone reboot recovery, external-provider exactly-once delivery and privacy-preserving attestation remain unproven.
projects.single_extra_feature: Sovereign Proof-Carrying Autonomy: proof-carrying completion plus a strict private-past/public-present/future-lab truth boundary.
projects.8x8_parity_gate: Bind the accepted SPCA contracts to real native ingress, council/control workers, sandboxed execution and external-effect adapters; then close interoperability, security, performance and adoption denominators.

projects.evidence_summary: Low-code workflows, agent applications, plugin extension points, APIs and workflow execution logs form an integrated application platform.
projects.single_extra_feature: Visual workflow-to-application/API productization with a plugin platform.
projects.8x8_parity_gate: Expose evidence-safe public workflows as versioned APIs while retaining One-Fabric authority and receipt semantics.

projects.evidence_summary: Durable application execution resumes after crashes, network failures and infrastructure outages, including long-running workflows.
projects.single_extra_feature: Crash-proof workflow continuation as the default execution model.
projects.8x8_parity_gate: Extend the accepted repository process-death canary to native worker-kill, service restart, reboot and duplicate-delivery recovery with no lost or duplicated committed effect.

projects.evidence_summary: A Docker-based sandbox runtime isolates arbitrary code execution from the host and supports agent software-engineering actions.
projects.single_extra_feature: Purpose-built isolated coding runtime for arbitrary agent code execution.
projects.8x8_parity_gate: Make risky creation/execution lanes sandbox-first with explicit filesystem, network and secret capabilities recorded in receipts.

projects.evidence_summary: Persistent replicated streams, durable consumers, acknowledgements, replay, deduplication and exactly-once quality-of-service mechanisms.
projects.single_extra_feature: Replicated durable messaging with deduplication and double-ack semantics.
projects.8x8_parity_gate: Keep SQLite as the single-node default, but prove transport abstraction and multi-node delivery parity before any distributed-bus promotion.

projects.evidence_summary: Autonomous TypeScript agents combine persistent memory with a broad plugin model spanning social, API and blockchain actions.
projects.single_extra_feature: A broad composable plugin ecosystem for autonomous social and on-chain actions.
projects.8x8_parity_gate: Map every connector/plugin into capability, authority, freshness and receipt contracts before claiming ecosystem parity.

projects.evidence_summary: A personal server, peer-to-peer network and decentralized cryptographic identity system provide a strongly sovereign computing model.
projects.single_extra_feature: Cryptographic self-owned network identity bound to a deterministic personal server.
projects.8x8_parity_gate: Add a formally scoped sovereign identity/attestation layer without coupling owner secrets to the public projection.

frontier.definition: Every consequential agent/tool/external effect must carry an authorization-bound, idempotent, replay-verifiable proof receipt before terminal completion; a future privacy-preserving attestation layer may prove policy compliance without disclosing prompts, secrets or private topology.
frontier.why_it_is_one_feature: It is one completion law applied uniformly to agents, tools, connectors and external effects rather than a bundle of unrelated product features.
